♉ The Taurus Cloth. [OFFENSE]

Cloth Passive — Bulwark

You cannot be moved against your will by any creature or effect of your size or smaller. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and to your DC against Shove, Trip, Grapple, and Disarm.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Great Horn]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Pleiades Nova]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Titan's Stance]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Titan's Break: The Golden Horn]

Ascendant Boon — The Great Horn [OFFENSE]

Your unarmed Strikes gain +1 damage die and force a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure the target is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

You count as one size larger whenever that benefits you.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Taurus)]

Zenith Boon — The Great Horn (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, but with +2 damage dice in total.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the start of each of your turns, and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Great Horn] costs no Focus Point once per round.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Taurus)]

rules.text: You cannot be moved by anything your size or smaller, and your DC against Shove, Trip, Grapple, and Disarm is 2 higher.
